title: mentha × rotundifolia f. elongata
intro: Mentha × rotundifolia f. elongata, commonly known as elongated round mint or apple mint, is a variant of the round mint plant (Mentha × rotundifolia). It is a hybrid species of mint that is valued for its unique elongated leaves and its various health benefits. The health benefits of Mentha × rotundifolia f. elongata include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as menthone, menthol, and limonene.
